description: Thresholds for the Arkham explainable-risk gate

severe_categories.description: Risk categories treated as severe (e.g. 'sanctions', 'hacker', 'ransomware', 'mixer', 'darkweb'). Only exposure in these categories can trigger the hop, materiality and recency rules.

max_severe_hop_distance.description: Exposure to a severe category within this many transaction hops denies outright, at any value above the dust floor. 1 means direct and one-hop exposure deny.

material_exposure_usd.description: Beyond max_severe_hop_distance, severe exposure denies only once the contributed USD value exceeds this threshold.

recent_exposure_days.description: Beyond max_severe_hop_distance, severe exposure also denies when the most recent linking transaction is within this many days, regardless of value.

dust_tolerance_usd.description: Paths contributing at or below this USD value are ignored entirely, so dusting attacks cannot brick a wallet. Set to 0 to consider every path.

deny_on_seed.description: When true, deny if the address is itself a known risky source rather than merely exposed to one.

max_risk_score.description: Maximum tolerated Arkham headline risk score (0-100), applied independently of the path analysis.

max_data_age_seconds.description: Maximum tolerated age of the Arkham observation. Null ages from the oracle fail-soft and do not trigger this rule.
